emma_sales: @sophie quick sync — Polaris POC started this morning. Customer seeing slow TTFT and some 429s. Also they asked for security questionnaire and pricing impact. Can we swarm?
liam_se: on it. Sophie, can you confirm model + average payload size and any logs you have?
sophie_customer: using gptx-6b-ish, payloads ~1–2 KB, context ~512 tokens. FT around 1200ms normally, spikes to 3s. 429s happen when we send 40–50 concurrent preflight requests.
maya_eng: 1200ms FT is high. Two usual suspects: the batcher holding requests to form micro-batches, or KV cache warmup misses. Any X-Cache-Hit headers in responses? Also are you on Hosted or Dedicated?
sophie_customer: Hosted. 429 responses included Retry-After: 2. We saw bursts during load tests. No X-Cache-Hit in our logs yet.
oliver_support: likely client-side concurrency + runtime batching. Recommend small warmup: send a few warmup requests to populate KV cache. Also share a sample request JSON so we can validate headers.
sophie_customer: sample request below:
```json
{"model":"gptx-6b","input":"Summarize this...","max_tokens":200}
```
liam_se: thanks. Also check if you have 'prefer_low_latency' or 'latency_slo_ms' set. By default runtime may prioritize batching to save cost. If you need low TTFT set 'latency_slo_ms': 500 on the route.
maya_eng: add-on: check for X-Cache-Hit: true/false and X-Request-Latency. If cache hits are false on first token, that'll add KV load time. Warmup + prefetch_kv can help.
emma_sales: pricing question from Sophie: if we add warmup requests, how will billing change? Also CISO wants SOC2 details and data residency answers.
sophie_customer: yes we'll need an estimate for warmup token cost. CISO also wants clarity on logs retention and VPC options.
oliver_support: warmup tokens are billable like normal token usage — small overhead. Recommend one small warmup per shard per hour; usually under 0.1% additional cost. For security, point them to Private/VPC option for stricter residency.
security-bot: SOC2 + security docs: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2. For formal questionnaire, we can provide the standard security pack and SSO/KMS details.
liam_se: immediate mitigation: change route config to 'latency_preference': 'low' to reduce batching hold intervals. Also consider 'prefetch_kv': true to asynchronously warm caches.
maya_eng: if 429s persist (Retry-After 2s), client should implement exponential backoff with jitter and limit parallelism. For sustained needs, propose Dedicated burst capacity.
emma_sales: Sophie — want me to open a ticket to quote warmup cost and kick off the security questionnaire? I can loop legal/solutions.
sophie_customer: please do. If we can get FT under 400ms and stable under concurrent users we'll sign.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: INC-3421 — Polaris POC perf/swarm. Assigned: liam_se, maya_eng, oliver_support.
liam_se: I'll gather logs (X-Cache-Hit, X-Request-Latency, model variant) and propose a config diff. Suggest quick call in ~20m to walk through.
emma_sales: Thanks team :rocket:
